notes:
Pass on the fake backend: the check exited 0 and every gate G1-G9 passed except the expected warning G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (the driver declares no limit on an actuating capability; its only invoke input is a string, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe). Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The card entry symbol redpitaya_client:RedPitayaClient was confirmed at src/redpitaya_client.py:9. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the PythonObjectDriver helper; this package is a direct decorated Driver over the upstream class because the upstream surface is one object with generic connect/send_cmd/query/close methods and a native stop/reset, which the decorated Driver expresses directly. The card's candidate cap.sensing.read.v1 binds resource kinds sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque (catalog show), not the instrument kind of this device, and the clone defines no fixed measurement channel; the package uses x-cap.andmorifa.scpi_query.v1 with an inline schema instead. NOT COVERED: the signal array. get_mock_data generates a synthetic sine wave with noise for testing without hardware (src/redpitaya_client.py:73-81; the mock generator makes 1024 samples at lines 79-80, a test-data size, not a device bound); it is not a device measurement and the driver does not expose or transfer it. The clone has no device-specific SCPI command table and no acquisition command (the only command text is the reset example GEN:RST at src/redpitaya_client.py:44), so the driver does not invent one; the extension forwards a caller-supplied query through query() and returns the response text. This is therefore a generic SCPI query driver: a caller must know the command set of the attached instrument. No Limit is declared because there is no numeric write or invoke input, and no site-limits.example.json is needed. The native stop is close (src/redpitaya_client.py:64-71); an operator reset reconnects with the upstream connect. Risk R0 is the card floor; no independent hardware e-stop is documented in the clone or claimed, and the loader protection for unreviewed model-written packages at R2 and R3 does not apply at R0. The clone has no packaging file, so native.py imports the top-level module redpitaya_client; a hardware operator must put the clone's src/ on PYTHONPATH (never done here). The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording; its start values and canned reply are placeholders marked in fake.py. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is the model and reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached, native.py was never imported and no device was connected. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
